acceptance_criteria: Test temporary roots use os.tmpdir or an injected root rather than literal /tmp.
Each test that writes mutable state owns a unique mkdtemp directory and removes it after use.
Parallel focused runs cannot collide through shared hardcoded paths.
The exact current path inventory contains no contradictory missing-path finding.
blast_radius: Cross-platform test execution, parallel isolation, temporary-state cleanup, and reproducibility on systems whose temporary directory is not /tmp.

impact: Literal and shared temporary paths can fail on nonstandard hosts, collide under parallel execution, and leave mutable fixtures coupled across tests.
